CBC.schema_assumption: four_report_format; future Audubon structure may be overhauled

representation: Presence-only; positive count-day records, grouped by species/site/comparison-year; no counts, effort, inferred absence or count-week-only detections
rules: January CBC belongs to previous year. Eligible and reported diagnostic presences remain distinguishable. Raw/harmonized labels are alternative views.
coordinates: Source database representative site coordinates; source datum assumption and historical metadata limitations apply.
crosswalk_scope: Harmonized crosswalk reviewed for lower48/DC and Canada; outside scope is exploratory.
menu_scope: Species with positive count-day display records in lower48/DC or Canada, by program; includes held records for the diagnostic view.
